<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1013
Claimant:
Lauren Stevens
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
4-4-23
Claimant reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection and stated they were stopped at the light when their
vehicle was struck from behind. They are not represented by counsel and have asked for the claim to be handled
directly.
5-31-23
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver reporting the loss is named on it and the coverage was active at the
time of the incident. Police report and both drivers' statements have been requested.
6-7-23
Spoke with the other driver, who described the collision the same way the claimant did. Two witnesses at the scene
have been contacted, and photos taken on the day show rear-end damage consistent with the reported impact.
Police confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle when officers arrived.
6-27-23
Claimant reports neck and back pain beginning the day of the accident and has provided medical records showing a
back strain diagnosis. The injury fits the force and direction of the collision, and no prior treatment to the same area is
known from the records or the claimant's history.
7-20-23
A neighbor mentioned seeing the vehicle with body damage several weeks before the claimed loss date. This has
been noted for follow-up, and the claimant has been asked to clarify any earlier damage to the vehicle. No prior
damage has been recorded on file so far.
8-4-23
Claimant has given the same account of the accident in every conversation so far. Medical treatment followed a
typical course and tapered off as recovery progressed, and the vehicle damage estimate is largely in line with the
described impact. Claim is progressing with the neighbor comment still open for review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
